'''Maritte''' was a female [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] of [[biochemist]]ry living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Residing on [[Vaiken Spacedock]], she managed a small shop, also teaching the knowledge of biochemistry to others.
